# secopsctl integrations

Manage SOAR integration instances (imperative create/delete)

## integrations action create

MUTATING (guarded): create a custom action definition

> Guarded mutation — dry-run by default; apply with `--yes`.

```text
secopsctl integrations action create --integration <key> (--file <def.json> | --name <display> --script <file.py>) [flags]
```

```text
Create a custom Python action definition. Either supply the complete
definition JSON (--file, e.g. an edited `template` output), or let the
command fetch the template and fill --name/--script/--description into it.
The definition is created with the template's enabled state (disabled for a
fresh template); enable it from the IDE once reviewed.
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--async` | bool | false | author the asynchronous-action variant |
| `--description` | string | - | definition description |
| `--dry-run` | bool | false | preview only (default behavior) |
| `--file` | string | - | complete definition JSON (an edited 'template' output) |
| `--integration` | string | - | integration key the definition belongs to (required) |
| `--name` | string | - | display name for the new definition |
| `--script` | string | - | Python source file for the definition body |
| `--yes` | bool | false | apply for real / skip confirmation |

## integrations action update

MUTATING (guarded): patch fields of an existing custom action definition

> Guarded mutation — dry-run by default; apply with `--yes`.

```text
secopsctl integrations action update --integration <key> --id N (--script <f.py> | --description <s>) [flags]
```

```text
Update an existing custom Python action definition by its numeric id
(from `playbooks components actions` or a prior create).
It is a sparse PATCH — pass only what changes (`--script` swaps the Python
body, `--description` the text) and only those fields are touched. Create is
a separate verb; a save here never creates a duplicate.
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--description` | string | - | new definition description |
| `--dry-run` | bool | false | preview only (default behavior) |
| `--id` | string | - | the definition's numeric id (required; from 'components actions') |
| `--integration` | string | - | integration key the definition belongs to (required) |
| `--script` | string | - | Python source file to set as the new definition body |
| `--yes` | bool | false | apply for real / skip confirmation |

## integrations configure

MUTATING (guarded): set an integration instance's parameters

> Guarded mutation — dry-run by default; apply with `--yes`.

```text
secopsctl integrations configure --integration <id> --param key=value … [flags]
```

```text
Read an integration instance's current settings, overlay the given
--param key=value pairs, and save the updated configuration.

A secret-valued parameter can reference an environment variable:
  --param 'API_Key=env:MY_SECRET_VAR'
The env var is resolved at apply time; the secret never appears in
shell history (use single-quotes) or in a tracked file.

Instance id and environment are auto-resolved when the integration
has a single instance (same as `integration delete`). Guarded: dry-run
by default, --yes to apply.
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--dry-run` | bool | false | preview only (default behavior) |
| `--environment` | string | - | instance environment (auto-resolved) |
| `--id` | string | - | instance identifier (auto-resolved when the integration has one) |
| `--integration` | string | - | installed integration identifier (required) |
| `--param` | stringArray | - | key=value to set (repeatable); use env:VAR for secrets |
| `--yes` | bool | false | apply for real / skip confirmation |

## integrations delete

Delete an integration instance (warns if playbooks use it)

> Guarded mutation — dry-run by default; apply with `--yes`.

```text
secopsctl integrations delete --integration <id> [--environment <env>] [--id <instance-id>] [flags]
```

```text
Delete an integration instance. When `--id` / `--environment` are omitted they
are resolved from the integration's instances — a single instance is selected
automatically; several list themselves so you can narrow. Guarded: dry-run by
default, --yes to apply.
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--dry-run` | bool | false | preview only (default behavior) |
| `--environment` | string | - | environment the instance is scoped to (resolved from --integration when omitted) |
| `--id` | string | - | instance identifier to delete (resolved when the integration has one instance) |
| `--integration` | string | - | installed integration identifier (required) |
| `--yes` | bool | false | apply for real / skip confirmation |

## integrations get

Show integration detail: instances, version, playbook usage

```text
secopsctl integrations get <identifier>
```

```text
Fetch a rich view of one installed integration: metadata, configured
instances across environments, and which playbooks use it. The
<identifier> is the integration identifier (e.g. 'GoogleChronicle').
```

## integrations rename

MUTATING (guarded): rename an integration instance

> Guarded mutation — dry-run by default; apply with `--yes`.

```text
secopsctl integrations rename --integration <id> (--instance <uuid> | --env <env>) --name <new-name> [flags]
```

```text
Rename an integration instance's displayName via the v1alpha PATCH surface.
Identify the instance by its UUID (--instance) or by integration + environment
(--env resolves to the single instance in that environment).
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--dry-run` | bool | false | preview without mutating |
| `--env` | string | - | environment name (resolves to the instance in that env) |
| `--instance` | string | - | instance UUID |
| `--integration` | string | - | integration identifier/key (required) |
| `--name` | string | - | new display name (required) |
| `--yes` | bool | false | skip confirmation prompt |

## integrations scaffold

Offline: scaffold a Python-backed custom integration directory

```text
secopsctl integrations scaffold --name <integration> --out <dir> [--action <name>] [--job <name>] [flags]
```

```text
Create a local custom integration scaffold with Python action/job
templates and JSON definition placeholders. This command is offline:
package it with `soar package-integration`, then let SecOps validate it
during import and playbook debug/run.
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--action` | stringArray | - | custom action name to scaffold (repeatable) |
| `--force` | bool | false | overwrite existing scaffold files |
| `--job` | stringArray | - | custom job name to scaffold (repeatable) |
| `--name` | string | - | custom integration name (required) |
| `--out` | string | - | output directory (default: ./<name>) |

## integrations test

Test integration connectivity (default instance, or --instance <id>)

```text
secopsctl integrations test <identifier> [flags]
```

```text
Run a connectivity test on the specified integration's instance.
By default tests the first configured instance; pass --instance <id>
to test a specific one. Reports pass/fail with the error message.
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--instance` | string | - | specific instance ID to test (default: first configured) |
